name: find_vendor
description: Find a vendor of the signed-in person's company by vendor id (such as V001) or by part of its name. Returns the vendor id, name and payment terms, or an empty list when nothing matches.

query.description: A vendor id such as V001, or part of a vendor name

name: list_open_invoices
description: List the company's unpaid invoices, with amounts in cents and due dates. Filter by vendor id, by a last due date, or both. Pass null for a filter you do not need.

vendor_id.description: Only this vendor's invoices, such as V001, or null for all vendors

due_by.description: Only invoices due on or before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD, or null for any date

name: get_purchase_order
description: Get the purchase order matched to one invoice, by invoice number (such as INV-8303). Returns the PO number, its amount in cents and whether it needs approval, or an error when the invoice has no purchase order.

invoice_number.description: An invoice number such as INV-8303

name: search_policy
description: Search the company's AP policy. Returns up to three passages, each with a citation such as purchasing.md:4, or says that no passage matches. Cite the passage you use.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words, such as small repairs
